FP_+=P_+ and FP_-=-P_- prove image inclusion in the kernels; applying each half-sum to a plus/minus vector proves the reverse inclusion. Sum identity gives existence of the decomposition and invertible2 gives zero intersection. Its kernel is the three-dimensional span(b00,b11,b01+b10). Since -1=1, the alleged two eigenspaces coincide with that kernel; they neither form a direct sum nor span the four-dimensional tensor square. No scalar1/2 exists.
